purpose: Define the safety contract future LilHouse agents must follow.
principles: Read state, summaries, indexes, and raw evidence before deciding.
Summaries are hints, not replacements for raw evidence.
Execution must go through guarded commands only.
Router-impacting changes require explicit operator approval.
Storage history must remain accessible from install time onward.
agent_workflow: Read the storage maintenance dry-run report.
Read additive storage summaries when available.
Query hot and archived history for relevant evidence.
Preview raw evidence with bounded line limits.
Classify as observe, watch, propose, alert, guarded_execute_request, or blocked.
Execute only through guarded commands after required approval.

decision_classes.propose: Suggest a change but do not execute.
decision_classes.alert: Notify the operator about a significant issue.
decision_classes.guarded_execute_request: Ask for explicit approval to run a guarded command.

forbidden_for_agents: change DHCP/NAT/firewall live without guarded approval
run live router deployment without the exact operator phrase
target production root without explicit live-root allowance
